notes: Accept, after corrections made in place. The extraction read the published Inventiones text (open access); Springer served this review only a JavaScript challenge, so the review read arXiv 2307.01303v3 (21 January 2025, three days before acceptance) by statement number and records it in sourceVersions; the nine new findings are scoped to v3. All four recorded mistakes are confirmed, including the gap E4 in Lemma 5.7 for p ≥ 3 (recomputed: the coefficients of exp in the closed-disc Tate algebra have valuation s_p(n)/(p − 1), which does not tend to infinity). Nine misprints are added (E5–E13), among them two citation slips ([37, Thm. 3.20] for the lift-induced decomposition, [35, Thm. 5.2] for almost purity) and a sign slip in the proof of Proposition 4.13. Routes 1, 3 and 4 are corrected in place and two coalescing routes are added; all six are accepted. Item 7 and item 1 are re-planned (P8:local-rational), item 12 becomes missing, five items are added (44–48), the other corrections touch items 6, 10, 11, 17, 21, 29, 35, 37 and 42, and item 3 moves to route 5. The result has 48 items (40 missing, 7 planned, 1 library). Three prerequisites that the atlas already covers (Scholze 2012 and 2013, Liu–Zhu) are removed.
